name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement single-qubit randomized benchmarkin
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement single-qubit randomized benchmarking from scratch in Qiskit: generate random Clifford sequences of lengths [1, 5, 10, 20, 40, 80] with recovery, run under depolarizing noise p=0.0033, fit the exponential decay, and report the error per Clifford. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
